content.short: Hex Trust is a regulated institutional custodian offering custody, staking and markets services.
content.description: Hex Trust provides fully regulated custody for institutions across several jurisdictions, alongside staking and markets services for builders, investors and service providers. Monad's documentation lists it under custody. Licensed custody is usually the gating requirement for regulated capital to touch a new chain at all, which is why chains court these providers early.
